stem: Charu studies a garden plant. It is short. Its stem is soft and green. It spreads along the ground and does not climb any support.

parts.text: How should Charu classify this plant?
Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A short plant with a soft stem that spreads on the ground without climbing a support is a creeper.

teacher.key_rationale: Creepers have weak stems that trail along the ground. This plant is short and soft-stemmed and does not climb, so it is not a tall woody tree, a many-stemmed woody shrub, or a climber that needs upright support.
